description: Service health of vLLM deployments: traffic, errors, latency SLOs, throughput and saturation.

panels.title: Requests / s
panels.description:
Requests finished per second, for any finish reason.

Metric: `vllm:request_success_total`

panels.title: Input tok/s
panels.description:
Prompt tokens per second, including tokens served from the prefix cache.

Metric: `vllm:prompt_tokens_total`

panels.title: Output tok/s
panels.description:
Generated tokens per second.

Metric: `vllm:generation_tokens_total`

panels.title: 5xx ratio
panels.description:
Share of API requests answered with a 5xx status. Errors that happen after a streaming response has started are not counted here; see *Finished requests by reason*. HTTP metrics are not labelled by model, so this follows the job and instance filters only.

Metric: `http_requests_total`

panels.title: TTFT p95
panels.description:
95th percentile time to first token: queueing, prefill and the first decode step.

Metric: `vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds`

panels.title: ITL p95
panels.description:
95th percentile time between consecutive streamed outputs.

Metric: `vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds`

panels.title: E2E p95
panels.description:
95th percentile request latency, from arrival to the last token.

Metric: `vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds`

panels.title: Unreachable
panels.description:
Scrape targets of the selected jobs that Prometheus cannot scrape (`up == 0`). A crashed or hung server shows up here while its vLLM metrics simply disappear.

Metric: `up`

panels.title: Engines
panels.description:
Engine cores reporting metrics: one per instance, or one per data-parallel rank.

Metric: `vllm:num_requests_running`

panels.title: Running
panels.description:
Requests in the engines' running batches.

Metric: `vllm:num_requests_running`

panels.title: Waiting
panels.description:
Requests queued for scheduling. A persistent queue means demand exceeds capacity.

Metric: `vllm:num_requests_waiting`

panels.title: KV cache
panels.description:
GPU KV cache usage of the most loaded engine.

Metric: `vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc`

panels.title: Preemptions
panels.description:
Running requests evicted per second to free KV cache. Preempted requests are recomputed later, which wastes GPU time and inflates latency.

Metric: `vllm:num_preemptions_total`

panels.title: Prefix hits
panels.description:
Share of prompt tokens looked up in the prefix cache that were found.

Metrics: `vllm:prefix_cache_hits_total`, `vllm:prefix_cache_queries_total`

panels.title: TTFT SLO
panels.description:
Share of requests whose time to first token was within the *TTFT SLO* selected above (${ttft_slo:text}). The threshold must be a bucket boundary of the histogram; pick one from the variable or add your own with `--custom-histogram-buckets`.

Metric: `vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds`

panels.title: TPOT SLO
panels.description:
Share of finished requests whose mean time per output token was within the *TPOT SLO* selected above (${tpot_slo:text}). The threshold must be a bucket boundary of the histogram.

Metric: `vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds`

panels.title: Per-model summary (selected time range)
panels.description: Each model's traffic, latency and saturation, aggregated over the dashboard time range. Click a model to filter the dashboard.

targets.expr: count by (model_name) (group by (model_name, instance) (last_over_time(vllm:num_requests_running{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model_name) (rate(vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))

sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance", finished_reason="error"}[$__range])) / (sum by (model_name) (rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Time to first token (TTFT)
panels.description:
Time from request arrival to the first output token, including queueing and prefill.

Metric: `vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds`

panels.title: Inter-token latency (ITL)
panels.description:
Time between consecutive streamed outputs, sampled for every output.

Metric: `vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds`

panels.title: Time per output token (TPOT)
panels.description:
Per-request mean time per output token after the first, recorded when a request finishes. Requests with a single output token record 0.

Metric: `vllm:request_time_per_output_token_seconds`

panels.title: End-to-end latency
panels.description:
Request latency from arrival to the last token. Percentiles below 0.3 s are interpolated inside the first bucket; use `--custom-histogram-buckets` for finer resolution.

Metric: `vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds`

panels.title: Queue time
panels.description:
Time requests spend waiting before they are first scheduled. Percentiles below 0.3 s are interpolated inside the first bucket; the mean is exact.

Metric: `vllm:request_queue_time_seconds`

panels.title: Mean time per request phase
panels.description:
Where an average request spends its time: waiting in the queue, prefilling the prompt, and decoding the output. Together they approximate the end-to-end latency.

Metrics: `vllm:request_{queue,prefill,decode}_time_seconds`

panels.title: TTFT distribution
panels.description:
Requests per second in each latency bucket. Bands reveal multi-modal latency that percentiles hide.

Metric: `vllm:time_to_first_token_seconds`

panels.title: Inter-token latency distribution
panels.description:
Requests per second in each latency bucket. Bands reveal multi-modal latency that percentiles hide.

Metric: `vllm:inter_token_latency_seconds`

panels.title: End-to-end latency distribution
panels.description:
Requests per second in each latency bucket. Bands reveal multi-modal latency that percentiles hide.

Metric: `vllm:e2e_request_latency_seconds`

panels.title: Token throughput
panels.description:
Prompt (input) and generated (output) tokens per second, per model.

Metrics: `vllm:prompt_tokens_total`, `vllm:generation_tokens_total`

panels.title: Finished requests by reason
panels.description:
*stop*: stop token or string. *length*: hit `max_tokens` or the context limit. *abort*: cancelled, usually by the client. *error*: failed inside the engine (returned as a server error). *repetition*: stopped by repetition detection.

Metric: `vllm:request_success_total`

panels.title: Scheduler queue
panels.description:
Requests being executed and requests waiting to be scheduled. *capacity*: waiting for KV cache or batch capacity. *deferred*: held back by a transient constraint such as the LoRA budget or a pending KV transfer.

Metrics: `vllm:num_requests_running`, `vllm:num_requests_waiting_by_reason`

panels.title: KV cache usage
panels.description:
Fraction of GPU KV cache blocks in use, across the selected engines. Running close to 100% is expected under load; new requests then wait for capacity and running ones may be preempted.

Metric: `vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc`

panels.title: Preemptions / s
panels.description:
Running requests evicted from the KV cache to make room for others. Sustained preemption means the KV cache is too small for the load: lower `--max-num-seqs`, add replicas, or give the cache more memory.

Metric: `vllm:num_preemptions_total`

panels.title: Tokens per engine step
panels.description:
Tokens (prefill + decode) processed per engine step, a proxy for batch size. Compare against `--max-num-batched-tokens`. Percentiles are interpolated within power-of-two buckets; the mean is exact.

Metric: `vllm:iteration_tokens_total`

panels.title: Cache hit rates
panels.description:
Share of looked-up tokens (prefix caches) or items (multimodal cache) that were already cached. *external* is the KV connector's cross-instance cache and only appears when one is configured.

Metrics: `vllm:prefix_cache_{hits,queries}_total`, `vllm:external_prefix_cache_{hits,queries}_total`, `vllm:mm_cache_{hits,queries}_total`

panels.title: Prompt tokens by source
panels.description:
Where prompt tokens came from: computed by prefill, reused from the local prefix cache, or loaded from another instance or an external cache through a KV connector.

Metric: `vllm:prompt_tokens_by_source_total`

panels.title: Prompt length
panels.description:
Prompt tokens per finished request. Percentiles are interpolated within 1-2-5 buckets.

Metric: `vllm:request_prompt_tokens`

panels.title: Output length
panels.description:
Generated tokens per finished request. Percentiles are interpolated within 1-2-5 buckets.

Metric: `vllm:request_generation_tokens`

panels.title: Finish reason share
panels.description:
Share of finished requests by finish reason. A rising *length* share means outputs are being truncated by `max_tokens` or the context window.

Metric: `vllm:request_success_total`

targets.expr: sum by (finished_reason) (rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) / ignoring (finished_reason) group_left () (sum(rate(vllm:request_success_total{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) > 0)

panels.title: Prompt length distribution
panels.description:
Share of requests finished in the selected time range, per length bucket. Bars are labelled by the bucket's upper bound in tokens; *+Inf* holds requests above the largest bucket.

Metric: `vllm:request_prompt_tokens`

targets.expr: sum by (le) (increase(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / on () group_left () (sum(increase(vllm:request_prompt_tokens_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: Output length distribution
panels.description:
Share of requests finished in the selected time range, per length bucket. Bars are labelled by the bucket's upper bound in tokens; *+Inf* holds requests above the largest bucket.

Metric: `vllm:request_generation_tokens`

targets.expr: sum by (le) (increase(vllm:request_generation_tokens_bucket{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) / on () group_left () (sum(increase(vllm:request_generation_tokens_count{job=~"$job", model_name=~"$model_name", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.title: HTTP requests by status
panels.description:
API requests per second by status class. Health, metrics and other probe endpoints are excluded. Follows the job and instance filters only.

Metric: `http_requests_total`

panels.title: HTTP requests by endpoint
panels.description:
API requests per second by route. Follows the job and instance filters only.

Metric: `http_requests_total`

panels.title: HTTP mean duration by endpoint
panels.description:
Mean time to serve an API request, including streaming the full response. Follows the job and instance filters only.

Metric: `http_request_duration_seconds`
